title: fix(telegram): cap rich block depth measurement
body:
Fixes #160431

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes lost Telegram replies when assistant Markdown contains deeply nested `<details>` blocks.

## User Impact

Deep replies retain rich formatting through 15 container levels and preserve deeper text and media source URLs inside the rich message, rather than overflowing the stack. Ordinary details, lists, and inline formatting remain unchanged. No configuration changes or migrations are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The previous list-only guard ran after recursive rendering, and the original depth constant was unused. Bound HTML parsing and emission before recursive consumers, use iterative measurement and plain-text projection, and normalize rendered and caller-supplied blocks before splitting or serialization. Telegram Test Server accepts 15 nested details containers plus a paragraph leaf, but rejects 16 with `RICH_MESSAGE_DEPTH_INVALID`.

The review follow-up also preserves image, video, and audio source URLs at both early HTML cutoffs. Normal text projection is unchanged. It fixes the content-loss finding rather than merely fixing lint.

Preserves @Ayushdevo's original commit and credit. Thanks to @hpyhandsome for the concrete reproduction.

No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes.

## Evidence

Final candidate: `31d49ef08bfd5115ab611b22c754f78441957750`.

- **Real Telegram path:** an isolated built Gateway received a Test Server user turn and a deterministic assistant reply containing 5,000 nested details. Current main (`a9665e46cc28db91063e21a06fdc0fd814231773`) failed outbound delivery with `Maximum call stack size exceeded`; no assistant payload arrived, only a generic failure notice. On the final candidate, one `messageRichMessage` arrived. TDLib `getFullRichMessage` confirmed `is_full=true`, all 5,000 summary characters, the leaf marker, and all three image/video/audio source URLs placed beyond the depth cutoff. No depth rejection, stack overflow, or whole-message plain fallback occurred.
- **Real OpenAI control:** ran on `ef0583a20f3d88ab66f1916ce8eabdc62cfedf6b`, before the lint and media-source follow-ups. A normal Markdown response arrived as `messageRichMessage` with paragraph and list nodes. Two real provider requests total, both HTTP 200. This ordinary-content observation is retained; the final-head mock Telegram and compatibility proofs were rerun. The credential was file-mounted read-only and deleted afterwards.
- **Compatibility:** a three-level details/list fixture produced byte-identical serialized blocks, plain text, and degradation reasons on base and final candidate (SHA-256 `2c38123dc82ee10b19b6585b8375aec2b95cae62e703b3789f60491267fe0c94`). Existing list and HTML-island cases pass unchanged.
- **Regression:** raw Markdown and supplied-block cases failed before with `RangeError`. Additional depth-31/depth-61 media cases failed before the review repair because URLs disappeared. Final focused run: 189 owner tests plus one temporary compatibility control passed in 2.11 seconds. New cases took 119 ms, 8 ms, 2 ms, and 3 ms. Owner command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/rich-blocks.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/rich-blocks-html.test.ts` (the compatibility fixture was included in the measured run).
- **Checks:** scoped Oxfmt and Oxlint passed on all six changed files. `OPENCLAW_RUN_NODE_SKIP_DTS_BUILD=1 pnpm build` passed in secretless Docker. The previous pushed head's two lint jobs failed on this PR's formatting/lint issues; those are corrected in the follow-up. Project-wide validation belongs to CI.

<details>
<summary>Sanitized final-head Telegram observations</summary>

```text
baseline: telegram final reply failed: OutboundDeliveryError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
candidate: rich-degrade=nesting-limit
candidate TDLib: messageRichMessage, is_full=true
candidate content: summaries=5000, leaf-marker=present
candidate media: a.jpg=present, a.mp4=present, a.mp3=present
candidate: RICH_MESSAGE_DEPTH_INVALID=absent, stack-overflow=absent
wire-depth probe: 3/8/12/14/15 accepted; 16 rejected
```

The depth-probe messages were deleted, including the initially uncertain receipt recovered through the leased user driver. Runner-owned Gateway/credential scratch state was removed and leases released.

</details>
